canonical_policy.name: Unit of Work is commit boundary
canonical_policy.normalized_policy: Use IUnitOfWork as the normal commit boundary for an Application use case; repositories stage changes and Application Services decide when to commit.

reviews.boundary_analysis: Staging versus commit authority, common DbContext implementation and no caching-invalidation bypass are covered. EXTRA0090 and EXTRA0125 already preserve tracked-entity/UoW and direct-update consistency cautions.

  application's `DbContext`.
